Write any EXCLURAD input files you produce next to it. If the request is physically impossible, refuse and say why. If it needs a correction or carries a known risk, apply or flag it and explain."

Also write any input files produced next to it.

Typically threshold W > m_p + m_eta ~ 0.938 + 0.547 = 1.485 GeV. So W=1.2 GeV is below threshold; physically impossible to produce eta meson. Therefore request is physically impossible. Must refuse, with explanation.
